title: "Dark Mode" switch destroys user's theme choices
line: When your look differs from the current global theme, the Dark Mode switch now warns before replacing it, with a Switch Anyway button.
explanation: The Dark Mode switch in Brightness & Color simply ran plasma-apply-lookandfeel with the light or dark global theme from Quick Settings. Any color scheme, cursor, icons or other setting the user had changed from the current global theme was overwritten without warning and never came back. The applet now compares the user's settings with the current global theme's defaults file; if any differ, clicking the switch leaves it unchanged and shows an inline warning with a Switch Anyway button (or a close button to keep the current look). Unmodified themes still switch immediately.

commits.message:
applets/brightness: warn before Dark Mode replaces a customized look

The Dark Mode switch applied the other global theme right away, silently
replacing any color scheme, cursor or other setting the user had changed
from the current theme. Now it shows a warning with a Switch Anyway button.

BUG: 522868

media.caption: Master, with the Oxygen color scheme and Oxygen Blue cursor: one click on Dark Mode applies Breeze Dark and the custom choices are gone.
With the fix, the same click shows a warning; Oxygen and the cursor stay until Switch Anyway is pressed.

review.text: Showing an inline warning with a Switch Anyway action in Brightness & Color is the right UX direction and matches the bug discussion, and the UI looks clean in the after screenshot. However, lookModified() only compares user config keys against the currently active lookAndFeelPackage()'s defaults without checking whether that package is actually one of the configured Quick Settings light/dark themes, so switching away from a third global theme (e.g. Breeze Twilight or a custom global theme) still silently destroys it with no warning. There are also minor soundness issues with KConfig(fileName) merging kdeglobals into other config files and the warning staying visible across popup close/reopen.
changes: In DarkModeControl::lookModified(), check first whether m_settings->lookAndFeelPackage() matches the expected configured theme (defaultDarkLookAndFeel() when m_darkMode is true, defaultLightLookAndFeel() when false) and return true if it differs; update the Kirigami.InlineMessage text so it accurately covers replacing a different global theme as well as customized settings.
Construct KConfig(fileName, KConfig::NoGlobals) in lookModified() so keys from kdeglobals are not merged into other config files (such as plasmarc or kwinrc) on shared group names like [General].

Reset modifiedMessage.visible = false when the applet popup closes (or when currentTheme/otherTheme changes), not only on darkModeChanged, so a dismissed-by-closing popup does not retain a stale warning.
